audit_status.source_base: Hebrew/Aramaic source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft translation of Ezra 8 rendered closely to the supplied Hebrew. Proper names preserved; a few lines show bracketed / variant readings in source flagged for witness review. Weighings and units kept literal (talents, shekels, drams).

verses.restored: And these are the chiefs of their fathers, and the genealogical registration of those who went up with me from Babylon in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

familiar.text: These are now the chief of their fathers, and this is the genealogy of them that went up with me from Babylon, in the reign of Artaxerxes the king.

modern.text: These are the family heads and genealogical records of those who returned with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:

original.text: וְאֵ֛לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אֲבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֑ם הָעֹלִ֣ים עִמִּ֗י בְּמַלְכ֛וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִבָּבֶֽל

verses.restored: Of the sons of Phinehas: Gershom. Of the sons of Ithamar: Daniel. Of the sons of David: Hattush.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Phinehas; Gershom: of the sons of Ithamar; Daniel: of the sons of David; Hattush.

modern.text: from the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; from the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel; from the descendants of David, Hattush

original.text: מִבְּנֵ֤י פִֽינְחָס֙ גֵּֽרְשֹׁ֔ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אִיתָמָ֖ר דָּנִיֵּ֑אל מִבְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖יד חַטּֽוּשׁ

verses.restored: Of the sons of Shechaniah; of the sons of Pharosh, Zechariah — and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Shechaniah, of the sons of Pharosh; Zechariah: and with him were reckoned by genealogy of the males an hundred and fifty.

modern.text: of the descendants of Shecaniah; from the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men;

original.text: מִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁכַנְיָ֔ה מִבְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹ֖שׁ זְכַרְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֛וֹ הִתְיַחֵ֥שׂ לִזְכָרִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים

verses.restored: Of the sons of Pahath‑Moab: Elihoenai son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Pahath-Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;

original.text: מִבְּנֵי֙ פַּחַ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֶלְיְהֽוֹעֵינַ֖י בֶּן זְרַֽחְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ מָאתַ֥יִם הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: Of the sons of Shechaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Shechaniah; the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;

original.text: מִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁכַנְיָ֖ה בֶּן יַחֲזִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons also of Adin: Ebed (servant) son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

familiar.text: Of the sons also of Adin; Ebed the son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין עֶ֖בֶד בֶּן יוֹנָתָ֑ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons of Elam: Jeshaiah son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Elam; Jeshaiah the son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה בֶּן עֲתַלְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons of Shephatiah: Zebadiah son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Shephatiah; Zebadiah the son of Michael, and with him fourscore males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה זְבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן מִֽיכָאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֖וֹ שְׁמֹנִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: Of the sons of Joab: Obadiah son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

familiar.text: Of the sons of Joab; Obadiah the son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;

original.text: מִבְּנֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב עֹבַדְיָ֖ה בֶּן יְחִיאֵ֑ל וְעִמּ֕וֹ מָאתַ֛יִם וּשְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons of Shelomith: the son of Josiphiah; and with him an hundred and sixty males.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Shelomith; the son of Josiphiah, and with him an hundred and threescore males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י שְׁלוֹמִ֖ית בֶּן יוֹסִפְיָ֑ה וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons of Bebai: Zechariah son of Bebai; and with him twenty and eight males.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Bebai; Zechariah the son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י בֵבַ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן בֵּבָ֑י וְעִמּ֕וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons of Azgad: Johanan son of Hakkatan; and with him an hundred and ten males.

familiar.text: And of the sons of Azgad; Johanan the son of Hakkatan, and with him an hundred and ten males.

modern.text: from the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד יוֹחָנָ֖ן בֶּן הַקָּטָ֑ן וְעִמּ֕וֹ מֵאָ֥ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֖ה הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons of Adonikam, the last ones — their names are these: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah; and with them threescore males.

familiar.text: And of the last sons of Adonikam, whose names are these, Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them threescore males.

notes.title: short
notes.body: ‘Last sons’ (אֲדֹנִיקָם אַחֲרֹנִים) and ordering may reflect variant lists; witness-check advised.

modern.text: from the later descendants of Adonikam, these were their names: Eliphelet, Jeiel, and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנִיקָם֮ אַחֲרֹנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֔ם אֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט יְעִיאֵ֣ל וּֽשְׁמַעְיָ֑ה וְעִמָּהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the sons also of Bigvai: Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

familiar.text: Of the sons also of Bigvai; Uthai, and Zabbud, and with them seventy males.

modern.text: and from the descendants of Bigvai, both Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men. Ezra Sends for the Levites

original.text: וּמִבְּנֵ֥י בִגְוַ֖י עוּתַ֣י וזבוד וְעִמּ֖וֹ שִׁבְעִ֥ים הַזְּכָרִֽים

verses.restored: And I gathered them by the river that comes to Ahava; there we camped for three days. I inspected the people and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

familiar.text: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.

modern.text: Now I assembled these exiles at the canal that flows to Ahava, and we camped there three days. And when I searched among the people and priests, I found no Levites there.

original.text: וָֽאֶקְבְּצֵ֗ם אֶל הַנָּהָר֙ הַבָּ֣א אֶֽל אַהֲוָ֔א וַנַּחֲנֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֣ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וָאָבִ֤ינָה בָעָם֙ וּבַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וּמִבְּנֵ֥י לֵוִ֖י לֹא מָצָ֥אתִי שָֽׁם

verses.restored: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam — chiefs; and for Joiarib and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

familiar.text: Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan, and for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib, and for Elnathan, men of understanding.

modern.text: Then I summoned the leaders: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, as well as the teachers Joiarib and Elnathan.

original.text: וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֡ה לֶאֱלִיעֶ֡זֶר לַאֲרִיאֵ֡ל לִֽ֠שְׁמַעְיָה וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֨ן וּלְיָרִ֜יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֧ן וּלְנָתָ֛ן וְלִזְכַרְיָ֥ה וְלִמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים וּלְיוֹיָרִ֥יב וּלְאֶלְנָתָ֖ן מְבִינִֽים

verses.restored: And I commanded them concerning Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I set words in their mouth to speak to Iddo and to his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, that they should bring us ministers for the house of our God.

familiar.text: And I sent them with commandment unto Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and I told them what they should say unto Iddo, and to his brethren the Nethinims, at the place Casiphia, that they should bring unto us ministers for the house of our God.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Bracketed variant readings in source for verbs and ‘Iddo’ instructions; Casiphia (כָּסִפְיָא) appears twice — check witnesses.

modern.text: And I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, with a message for him and his kinsmen, the temple servants at Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

original.text: ואוצאה אוֹתָם֙ עַל אִדּ֣וֹ הָרֹ֔אשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָ֖א הַמָּק֑וֹם וָאָשִׂימָה֩ בְּפִיהֶ֨ם דְּבָרִ֜ים לְ֠דַבֵּר אֶל אִדּ֨וֹ אָחִ֤יו הנתונים בְּכָסִפְיָ֣א הַמָּק֔וֹם לְהָֽבִיא לָ֥נוּ מְשָׁרְתִ֖ים לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, a Levite, son of Israel; and Sherebiah with his sons and brothers, eighteen.

familiar.text: And by the good hand of our God upon us they brought us a man of understanding, of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah, with his sons and his brethren, eighteen;

modern.text: And since the gracious hand of our God was upon us, they brought us Sherebiah—a man of insight from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel—along with his sons and brothers, 18 men;

original.text: וַיָּבִ֨יאּוּ לָ֜נוּ כְּיַד אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ הַטּוֹבָ֤ה עָלֵ֨ינוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ שֶׂ֔כֶל מִבְּנֵ֣י מַחְלִ֔י בֶּן לֵוִ֖י בֶּן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֛ה וּבָנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר

verses.restored: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah, of the sons of Merari — their brothers and their sons, twenty.

familiar.text: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brethren and their sons, twenty;

modern.text: also Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah, from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and their sons, 20 men.

original.text: וְאֶת חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְאִתּ֥וֹ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖ה מִבְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֶחָ֥יו וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֶשְׂרִֽים

verses.restored: And of the Nethinim, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites: two hundred and twenty Nethinim; all of them were named.

familiar.text: Also of the Nethinims, whom David and the princes had appointed for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinims: all of them were expressed by name.

modern.text: They also brought 220 of the temple servants, all designated by name. David and the officials had appointed them to assist the Levites. Fasting for Protection

original.text: וּמִן הַנְּתִינִ֗ים שֶׁנָּתַ֨ן דָּוִ֤יד וְהַשָּׂרִים֙ לַעֲבֹדַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם נְתִינִ֖ים מָאתַ֣יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֖ם נִקְּב֥וּ בְשֵׁמֽוֹת

verses.restored: Then I proclaimed a fast there, by the river Ahava, that we might humble ourselves before our God to seek from him a right way for us, for our little ones, and for all our substance.

familiar.text: Then I proclaimed a fast there, at the river of Ahava, that we might afflict ourselves before our God, to seek of him a right way for us, and for our little ones, and for all our substance.

modern.text: And there by the Ahava Canal I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

original.text: וָאֶקְרָ֨א שָׁ֥ם צוֹם֙ עַל הַנָּהָ֣ר אַהֲוָ֔א לְהִתְעַנּ֖וֹת לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ וּלְטַפֵּ֖נוּ וּלְכָל רְכוּשֵֽׁנוּ

verses.restored: For I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy on the road, because we had told the king, saying, 'The hand of our God is upon all who seek him for good, but his power and his anger is against all who forsake him.'

familiar.text: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.

modern.text: For I was ashamed to ask the king for an escort of soldiers and horsemen to protect us from our enemies on the road, since we had told him, “The hand of our God is gracious to all who seek Him, but His great anger is against all who forsake Him.”

original.text: כִּ֣י בֹ֗שְׁתִּי לִשְׁא֤וֹל מִן הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חַ֣יִל וּפָרָשִׁ֔ים לְעָזְרֵ֥נוּ מֵאוֹיֵ֖ב בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ כִּֽי אָמַ֨רְנוּ לַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֗ר יַד אֱלֹהֵ֤ינוּ עַל כָּל מְבַקְשָׁיו֙ לְטוֹבָ֔ה וְעֻזּ֣וֹ וְאַפּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל עֹזְבָֽיו

verses.restored: So we fasted and besought our God about this, and he was entreated of us.

familiar.text: So we fasted and besought our God for this: and he was intreated of us.

modern.text: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and He granted our request. Priests to Guard the Offerings

original.text: וַנָּצ֛וּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁ֥ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ עַל זֹ֑את וַיֵּעָתֵ֖ר לָֽנוּ

verses.restored: Then I separated twelve of the chiefs of the priests: Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them.

familiar.text: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brethren with them,

modern.text: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers,

original.text: וָאַבְדִּ֛ילָה מִשָּׂרֵ֥י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר לְשֵׁרֵֽבְיָ֣ה חֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה וְעִמָּהֶ֥ם מֵאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה

verses.restored: And I weighed unto them the silver and the gold and the vessels — the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counselors, and his lords, and all Israel who were present had offered.

familiar.text: And weighed unto them the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, even the offering of the house of our God, which the king, and his counsellors, and his lords, and all Israel there present, had offered:

modern.text: and I weighed out to them the contribution of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his counselors, his leaders, and all the Israelites there had offered for the house of our God.

original.text: ואשקולה לָהֶ֔ם אֶת הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְאֶת הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת הַכֵּלִ֑ים תְּרוּמַ֣ת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ הַהֵרִ֨ימוּ֙ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְיֹעֲצָ֣יו וְשָׂרָ֔יו וְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּמְצָאִֽים

verses.restored: I weighed into their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels one hundred talents, and of gold one hundred talents.

familiar.text: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;

notes.title: short
notes.body: Units rendered literally as 'talents' per Hebrew כִּכָּרִים; confirm conversions and witness totals.

modern.text: I weighed out into their hands 650 talents of silver, articles of silver weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,

original.text: וָאֶשְׁקֲלָ֨ה עַל יָדָ֜ם כֶּ֗סֶף כִּכָּרִים֙ שֵֽׁשׁ מֵא֣וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים וּכְלֵי כֶ֥סֶף מֵאָ֖ה לְכִכָּרִ֑ים זָהָ֖ב מֵאָ֥ה כִכָּֽר

verses.restored: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

familiar.text: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.

modern.text: 20 gold bowls valued at 1,000 darics, and two articles of fine polished bronze, as precious as gold.

original.text: וּכְפֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ עֶשְׂרִ֔ים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּכְלֵ֨י נְחֹ֜שֶׁת מֻצְהָ֤ב טוֹבָה֙ שְׁנַ֔יִם חֲמוּדֹ֖ת כַּזָּהָֽב

verses.restored: And I said unto them: 'You are holy to YHWH, and the vessels are holy; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering to YHWH, the God of your fathers.'

familiar.text: And I said unto them, Ye are holy unto the LORD; the vessels are holy also; and the silver and the gold are a freewill offering unto the LORD God of your fathers.

modern.text: Then I told them, “You are holy to the LORD, and these articles are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.

original.text: וָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֥ם קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְהַכֵּלִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְהַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ נְדָבָ֔ה לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Keep and guard them until you weigh them before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and the chief of the fathers of Israel in Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of YHWH.

familiar.text: Watch ye, and keep them, until ye weigh them before the chief of the priests and the Levites, and chief of the fathers of Israel, at Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of the LORD.

modern.text: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests, Levites, and heads of the Israelite families.”

original.text: שִׁקְד֣וּ וְשִׁמְר֗וּ עַֽד תִּשְׁקְל֡וּ לִפְנֵי֩ שָׂרֵ֨י הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֛ם וְשָׂרֵֽי הָאָב֥וֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הַלִּשְׁכ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: So the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and the gold and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem to the house of our God.

familiar.text: So took the priests and the Levites the weight of the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem unto the house of our God.

modern.text: So the priests and Levites took charge of the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

original.text: וְקִבְּלוּ֙ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִשְׁקַ֛ל הַכֶּ֥סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֖ב וְהַכֵּלִ֑ים לְהָבִ֥יא לִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם לְבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: Then we departed from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy and those lying in wait along the road.

familiar.text: Then we departed from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go unto Jerusalem: and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of the enemy, and of such as lay in wait by the way.

modern.text: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem, and the hand of our God was upon us to protect us from the hands of the enemies and bandits along the way. Arrival in Jerusalem

original.text: וַֽנִּסְעָ֞ה מִנְּהַ֣ר אַֽהֲוָ֗א בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן לָלֶ֖כֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְיַד אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ הָיְתָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וַיַּ֨צִּילֵ֔נוּ מִכַּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֛ב וְאוֹרֵ֖ב עַל הַדָּֽרֶךְ

verses.restored: And we came to Jerusalem and abode there three days.

familiar.text: And we came to Jerusalem, and abode there three days.

modern.text: So we arrived at Jerusalem and rested there for three days.

original.text: וַנָּב֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַנֵּ֥שֶׁב שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה

verses.restored: Now on the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah the priest; with him Eleazar son of Phinehas; and with them Jozabad son of Jeshua, and Noadiah son of Binnui, Levites.

familiar.text: Now on the fourth day was the silver and the gold and the vessels weighed in the house of our God by the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, Levites;

modern.text: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and sacred articles into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, along with the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.

original.text: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֡י נִשְׁקַ֣ל הַכֶּסֶף֩ וְהַזָּהָ֨ב וְהַכֵּלִ֜ים בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ עַ֠ל יַד מְרֵמ֤וֹת בֶּן אֽוּרִיָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעִמּ֖וֹ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן פִּֽינְחָ֑ס וְעִמָּהֶ֞ם יוֹזָבָ֧ד בֶּן יֵשׁ֛וּעַ וְנֽוֹעַדְיָ֥ה בֶן בִּנּ֖וּי הַלְוִיִּֽם

verses.restored: By number and by weight of every one; and all the weight was written at that time.

familiar.text: By number and by weight of every one: and all the weight was written at that time.

modern.text: Everything was verified by number and weight, and the total weight was recorded at that time.

original.text: בְּמִסְפָּ֥ר בְּמִשְׁקָ֖ל לַכֹּ֑ל וַיִּכָּתֵ֥ב כָּֽל הַמִּשְׁקָ֖ל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא

verses.restored: Those who had been carried away and had returned offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, and twelve he‑goats for a sin offering — all as a burnt offering to YHWH.

familiar.text: Also the children of those that had been carried away, which were come out of the captivity, offered burnt offerings unto the God of Israel, twelve bullocks for all Israel, ninety and six rams, seventy and seven lambs, twelve he goats for a sin offering: all this was a burnt offering unto the LORD.

modern.text: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: 12 bulls for all Israel, 96 rams, 77 lambs, and a sin offering of 12 male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.

original.text: הַ֠בָּאִים מֵֽהַשְּׁבִ֨י בְנֵֽי הַגּוֹלָ֜ה הִקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹל֣וֹת לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּרִ֨ים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֤ר עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵילִ֣ים תִּשְׁעִ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֗ה כְּבָשִׂים֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֔ה צְפִירֵ֥י חַטָּ֖את שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הַכֹּ֖ל עוֹלָ֥ה לַיהוָֽה

verses.restored: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants and to the governors on this side the river; and they furthered the people and the house of God.

familiar.text: And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

modern.text: They also delivered the king’s edicts to the royal satraps and governors of the region west of the Euphrates, who proceeded to assist the people and the house of God.

original.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֶת דָּתֵ֣י הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וּפַחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר וְנִשְּׂא֥וּ אֶת הָעָ֖ם וְאֶת בֵּֽית הָאֱלֹהִֽים
